sentences.text: James Earl Jones -LRB- born January 17 , 1931 -RRB- is an American actor .	American	Americans

His career has spanned more than 60 years , and he has been described as `` one of America 's most distinguished and versatile '' actors and `` one of the greatest actors in American history . ''	American	Americans

Since his Broadway debut in 1957 , Jones has won many awards , including a Tony Award and Golden Globe Award for his role in The Great White Hope .	Broadway	Broadway theatre	Tony Award	Tony Award	Golden Globe Award	Golden Globe Award	The Great White Hope	The Great White Hope (film)

Jones has won three Emmy Awards , including two in the same year in 1991 , and he also earned an Academy Award nomination for Best Actor in a Leading Role in the film version of The Great White Hope .	The Great White Hope	The Great White Hope (film)	Academy Award	Academy Award	Best Actor in a Leading Role	Best Actor in a Leading Role

He is also known for his voice roles as Darth Vader in the Star Wars film series and Mufasa in Disney 's The Lion King as well as many other film , stage , and television roles .	Darth Vader	Darth Vader	Star Wars	Star Wars	Mufasa	Mufasa	Disney	Walt Disney Animation Studios	The Lion King	The Lion King

Jones has been said to possess `` one of the best-known voices in show business , a stirring basso profundo that has lent gravel and gravitas to '' his projects , including live-action acting , voice acting , and commercial voice-overs .	basso profundo	basso profundo
As a child , Jones had a stutter .	stutter	stutter
In his episode of Biography , he said he overcame the affliction through poetry , public speaking , and acting , although it lasted for several years .	Biography	Biography (TV series)

A pre-med major in college , he went on to serve in the United States Army during the Korean War before pursuing a career in acting .	pre-med	Pre-medical	major	Academic major	United States Army	United States Army	Korean War	Korean War
On November 12 , 2011 , he received an Honorary Academy Award .	Academy Award	Academy Award	Honorary Academy Award	Honorary Academy Award
On November 9 , 2015 , Jones received the Voice Arts Icon Award .
On May 25 , 2017 , he received an Honorary Doctor of Arts degree from Harvard University and concluded the event 's benediction with `` May the Force be with you '' .
